**Triage: lands across the remaining workspace manifests; `domain:devx`; `priority:p3`.**

⚠️ **⛔ Not a duplicate of objectui#8590** — it is that card's class residue **plus a correction to the probe**, and the correction is the valuable part.

### ⭐ The methodological half

objectui#8590 was measured **by reading manifests**. This card measured **by invoking each package** — and found **two more**. ⇒ manifest-reading **under-counts the class**, because a `test` script can exist and still match nothing.

That is the third instance of one lesson in this round, from three unrelated directions: objectstack#17304 (a fifth carrier in a wording the scan cannot match), objectui#8924 (a version-literal probe blind to the earlier cohort), and now this. ⭐ **A probe shaped like the example you already found cannot measure the class.**

⚠️ **⇒ objectui#8590's stated scope ("all four") is now known to be short.** A note has been added there. Whoever takes either card should work from **this** card's invocation-based population, ⛔ not #8590's manifest list.

### And the second correction

*"objectui#8590 proved the one-line fix is not uniformly safe."* ⇒ ⛔ do not apply one `test` script line to every package. Establish per package what its invocation should do, and ⚠️ remember the acceptance probe from #8590: the filtered spelling must **disagree with a broken test**, ⛔ not merely exit 0.

`Size/model suggestion:` M.

Triage's lesson on this card is 「**a probe shaped like the example you already found cannot measure the class**」, and objectui#8590's manifest-reading probe **under-counted**. ⇒ this seat re-read the manifests on `origin/main` = `d2f0c108c` as a **lower bound** — ⛔ explicitly the weak probe, named as such — over all **46** workspace manifests:

| package | `test` script | test-named files on disk |
|:--|:--|--:|
| `@object-ui/layout` | ⛔ **none** | **21** |
| `@object-ui/test-support` | ⛔ **none** | **5** |
| ⭐ `@object-ui/example-console-starter` | ⛔ **none** | **1** |
| `@object-ui/site` | ⛔ **none** | 0 |
| `@object-ui/example-byo-backend-console` | ⛔ **none** | 0 |
| `@object-ui/example-hello-world` | ⛔ **none** | 0 |

⇒ **six** manifests carry no `test` script, where the card names **three**. ⭐ `example-console-starter` has a test file **and** no script, so it is the card's defect exactly, ⛔ not the weaker no-tests-at-all sub-case — and the card does not mention it.

⚠️ ⛔ **Six is still a LOWER BOUND, and this reading is the very probe triage warned about.** A `test` script can **exist and match nothing** — that is how objectui#8590 under-counted. ⇒ the population is whatever **invoking every workspace package** returns, and that is yours to derive.

## ⭐ Three spellings are already in the tree, ⛔ so there is no single 「one line」

- the plain form — `vitest run --root ../.. packages/PKG/`;
- ⭐ `--passWithNoTests` — `plugin-ai` and the vscode extension;
- ⭐ `--no-passWithNoTests` — `@object-ui/console`, which is the **opposite** posture and exists because that package's script once collected zero files and exited **1**, loudly.

⇒ 「add the canonical line」 is ⛔ not a decision you can make from a template. Each member's correct spelling follows from what its invocation should do when it collects nothing.

## Premises

1. The file counts above are **filename globs**, ⛔ not Vitest collection counts — the card says so and it is still true. ⛔ Do not carry them into the PR as test counts.
2. `@object-ui/types` (objectui#8590's member) now carries the plain form and **175** test-named files ⇒ the control that this reading distinguishes a fixed member from a broken one.
3. ⚠️ No `node_modules` in the shared checkout, so ⛔ this seat could **not** invoke anything. Everything above is manifest-and-filename evidence only.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9105. ⭐ Three lines, and the reason each one is that line is verified in the config's own source

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-11T02:52Z. Reviewed against the diff, ⛔ not against the report's summary of it. **Three files, +3 / −0** — one `test` entry per manifest, ⛔ nothing else. Head `48d9680fc`.

### ⭐ The spelling decision is DERIVED, and I checked the derivation myself

The report's load-bearing claim is that the root config does not set `passWithNoTests` to a constant. Read in the config: `passWithNoTests: !cliHasTestFilters(process.argv)`. And read in the guard it imports: `cliHasTestFilters` returns true **only when positionals are present** (with `related` and `--changed` excluded by name).

⇒ every consequence follows mechanically, ⛔ not by taste:

| | why |
|:--|:--|
| the three new entries carry a **positional path filter** | ⇒ `passWithNoTests` derives **false** already ⇒ collecting zero exits **1**, loudly, **with no flag at all** |
| ⛔ `--passWithNoTests` would be wrong here | it would convert this very defect from silent-empty into **silent-empty-with-a-blessing**, over 21 real files |
| ⛔ `--no-passWithNoTests` would be redundant here | it restates what the config already derives for a filtered run |
| ⭐ why `@object-ui/console` legitimately carries `--no-passWithNoTests` | it filters by `--project`, which is a **flag, not a positional** ⇒ `cliHasTestFilters` is **false** there ⇒ the flag is what makes it loud |

⭐ That last row is the one I would have got wrong from a template, and it is checked in the source rather than assumed.

### ⭐ The population was derived by INVOCATION, and my lower bound turned out exact — with the measured negative I could not produce

I gave six manifests as an explicit **lower bound** from manifest-reading, the weak probe triage warned about. The invocation sweep over all workspace manifests returns **the same six** ⇒ the bound was exact. ⭐ But it adds the thing reading could never establish: **no script-bearing package under-collects today** — zero 「script exists but matches nothing」 cases, which is the failure mode that made objectui#8590's own probe short.

⭐ And the six split **3 / 3**, which is the finding: three are real members, three are a **different question**.

⚠️ ⭐ **The report also corrected one of my numbers, and was right to.** I quoted `@object-ui/types` at **175** test-named files; collection returns **174**. ⇒ a filename glob is not a Vitest collection count — the card says so, my premise ignored it, and the dev re-derived rather than inheriting it.

### ⭐ Three stopped and reported, and the reasoning is better than a fix would have been

`@object-ui/site`, `@object-ui/example-byo-backend-console`, `@object-ui/example-hello-world`: their **root-config** invocation exits **1**, not 0.

⇒ the card's acceptance — 「the same file count and the same test count, **both exiting 0**」 — is **unreachable** for a zero-test-file package. ⭐ And adding `--passWithNoTests` would make the package entry exit 0 while the root-config side exits 1: ⛔ **manufacturing the exact disagreement the card requires to be absent.**

⭐ `apps/site` carries a second, independent reason: the root config's shared exclude ends with `apps/**` and an app returns through the projects array rooted at its own directory, so a positional filter naming it can **never** match. ⇒ a `--passWithNoTests` entry there would be green **by construction** and could never notice a test file being added — the defect this card exists to kill, installed as a fix.

⇒ filed **bare** as objectui#9106 — verified unlabelled and unassigned — options laid out, none taken.

### ⛔ Boundaries — verified mechanically, ⛔ not accepted from the report

| check | reading |
|:--|--:|
| manifests with a `test` script | **40 → 43** ✅ |
| ⭐ `--passWithNoTests` occurrences across all manifests | **2 → 2** ⇒ ⛔ none of the three new entries carries it ✅ |
| `--no-passWithNoTests` occurrences | **1 → 1** ⇒ console's posture untouched ✅ |
| the config's `passWithNoTests: !cliHasTestFilters(…)` line | **present, unchanged** ✅ |
| test-named files in the three members | **27 → 27** ⇒ ⛔ no test added or removed to make numbers agree ✅ |
| files touched | **3 manifests**, ⛔ no test edited, no config edited ✅ |

### ⭐ The breakage probe is the one objectui#8590 demanded, run three times

「The filtered spelling must **disagree with a broken test**, ⛔ not merely exit 0.」 ⇒ one real mutation per member — a depth constant, a dispatched nav id, an alias-table floor — each **proven on disk before its run was believed** (anchor 1→0, mutant 0→1, blob hash printed), each going **red with exactly one failing file**, each restored to blob-hash equality with `git diff HEAD` empty. ⭐ An empty hash was coded to read as **failure**, and the restore trap carried an absolute path.

⇒ ⛔ 「exits 0」 was never accepted as evidence anywhere in this card.

### ⚠️ The honest disclaimer the report volunteers

CI runs the sharded root project, ⛔ **not** `turbo run test` — so all 27 files were **already running and already green** before this change. ⇒ what moves is the **developer-facing entry point**, and the PR claims no new coverage. ⭐ Saying so unprompted is the difference between a fix and a fix that oversells itself.

⇒ landing pipeline from here is this seat's.
